description.text:
The XY Trainer Kit: Latias & Latios, released on 29 April 2015, brought back the two Pokémon of the June 2004 EX Trainer Kit. As then, its Latias and Latios cards are its own, and they were the first English cards of the pair as Psychic types. Two 30-card half decks came with a deck box, a rule book, counters, a coin showing the Hoenn first partner Pokémon, a playmat and a Trainer Kit Guide for each half deck. The cards carry the kit's own set symbol and no rarity mark, numbered in the order the example battle draws them. In the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online, the kit's code unlocked the two halves combined as the Eon Strike theme deck.

The Latias half deck runs on Grass and Psychic Energy, numbered 1/30 to 30/30.

sources.title: Bulbapedia: XY Trainer Kit: Latias & Latios (TCG) (Wayback Machine copy, 2 August 2026)
